restoration-clause-learning.finding: The changed assumption is material: rollback evidence becomes persistent constraints over future update compositions rather than a one-shot fault set. The update surface, independent regression signal, frozen-transfer test, and matched-budget ablation are credible. However, the central learning step is not yet mathematically identifiable. A stochastic Beta-Bernoulli factor posterior does not directly define a logical unsatisfied core, and the proposal does not specify the clause language, confidence semantics, generalization rule, or objective that converts noisy intervention outcomes into reusable higher-order prohibitions. Existing work already covers probabilistic delta debugging, intervention-based agent failure attribution, and persistent governed symbolic repair; the surviving thesis therefore depends entirely on a precise and demonstrably useful probabilistic clause-induction rule.
restoration-clause-learning.finding_zh: 该子方案对父问题作出了实质性改变：回滚证据不再只输出一次性的故障集合，而是转化为约束未来更新组合的持久规则。更新表面、独立回归信号、冻结迁移测试和预算匹配消融均较可信。但核心学习步骤尚未具备数学可识别性：随机的 Beta-Bernoulli 因子后验并不会自然产生逻辑上的不可满足核心，方案也未定义子句语言、置信度语义、泛化规则，以及如何把带噪干预结果转化为可复用的高阶禁止规则。现有工作已经覆盖概率式差分调试、基于干预的智能体故障归因和持久化受治理符号修复，因此剩余的方法论文主张完全取决于一个精确定义且确有增益的概率子句归纳规则。
restoration-clause-learning.required_action: Replace the informal minimal-unsatisfied-core compilation with an explicit probabilistic clause-induction objective over a fixed typed descriptor language, including posterior updates, clause confidence and expiry, false-block control, and a comparison against a direct posterior-risk gate trained from exactly the same intervention history.
restoration-clause-learning.required_action_zh: 将非正式的“最小不可满足核心编译”替换为固定类型化描述符语言上的显式概率子句归纳目标，明确后验更新、子句置信度与失效机制、误阻断控制，并与使用完全相同干预历史训练的直接后验风险门控进行比较。

restoration-clause-learning.strongest_baseline: The same sparse interaction posterior and intervention history used as a direct composition-risk predictor and blocker, without compiling clauses, alongside PMA or ProbDD for current-fault localization.
restoration-clause-learning.decisive_pilot: Under identical update histories and rollout budgets, train the proposed clause registry and a direct posterior-risk gate on one model and two task domains; freeze both and evaluate unseen higher-order update combinations on a second model, measuring prevented regressions, unnecessary interventions, false blocks, and calibration.
restoration-clause-learning.stop_rule: Stop if the frozen clause registry fails to reduce unseen-composition regressions relative to the history-matched direct risk gate with a confidence interval excluding a meaningful gain, or if its upper 95% confidence bound on false-block rate exceeds 5%.
unknowns: No official source establishes the proposed public versioned-update harness with typed compositional updates and planted higher-order faults across ALFWorld and WebArena-Lite.

randomized-memory-action-policy.finding: The proposal is statistically coherent and improves identification over an observational future-harm predictor, but it does not supply a new memory-learning mechanism. Randomizing a finite action set, estimating action values with cross-fitted doubly robust estimators, and optimizing a support-constrained pessimistic policy are standard contextual-bandit and offline-policy-learning components. Recent memory systems already formulate memory operations as learned actions, use contextual-bandit exploration and delayed credit, include summarize or forget operations, and make abstention or non-use first-class decisions. Applying a canonical causal-policy stack to write, summarize, quarantine, and drop is therefore a direct recombination rather than a standalone ICLR method invention.
randomized-memory-action-policy.finding_zh: 该方案在统计上是连贯的，也比观察式未来危害预测器具有更强的可识别性，但它没有提出新的记忆学习机制。对有限动作集合进行随机化、使用交叉拟合双重稳健估计器估计动作价值，再优化受支持集约束的悲观策略，均属于标准的上下文赌博机和离线策略学习组件。近期记忆系统已经把记忆操作建模为可学习动作，采用上下文赌博机探索和延迟信用分配，包含摘要或遗忘操作，并将弃权或不使用记忆作为一等决策。因此，把经典因果策略学习流程应用于写入、摘要、隔离和删除，属于已有方法的直接重组，而不是独立的 ICLR 方法发明。
randomized-memory-action-policy.required_action: Replace the generic bandit formulation with a memory-specific causal mechanism that identifies retrieval-mediated delayed effects and interference among entries, and demonstrate an estimator or learning rule that cannot be reduced to a standard doubly robust contextual-bandit learner on the same randomized logs.
randomized-memory-action-policy.required_action_zh: 用记忆特有的因果机制替换通用赌博机建模，使其能够识别由后续检索介导的延迟效应和不同记忆条目之间的干扰，并证明所提出的估计器或学习规则不能被相同随机日志上的标准双重稳健上下文赌博机学习器替代。

randomized-memory-action-policy.strongest_baseline: MemCon extended to the same write, summarize, quarantine, and drop action set and trained from identical randomized histories, together with a generic cross-fitted doubly robust pessimistic contextual-bandit policy learner.
randomized-memory-action-policy.decisive_pilot: Generate one shared stratified-randomization log under fixed capacity, retrieval, interaction, and token budgets; train the proposed policy, a generic doubly robust pessimistic learner, and MemCon-style UCB control from that same log, then freeze all policies for a third-domain and second-model evaluation.
randomized-memory-action-policy.stop_rule: Stop if the proposed policy does not improve pessimistic lower-bound utility or valid coverage over the generic doubly robust learner under paired bootstrap confidence intervals, or if frozen third-domain valid coverage remains below 40%.
unknowns: It is unclear whether quarantine has operational consequences distinct from temporary non-retrieval or drop.

placebo-calibrated-memory-effects.finding: This remains an evaluation and gating procedure rather than a new learning mechanism. The hierarchical posterior and three replay arms are concrete, but defining semantic effect as retrieved-minus-none minus placebo-minus-none is causally valid only if the placebo is exchangeable with the real memory for every nonsemantic pathway and if semantic and nonsemantic effects do not interact. Token, position, and task-disjoint matching do not establish those assumptions; an irrelevant memory can change reasoning, difficulty, attention, or tool behavior in content-dependent ways. Controlled intervention-based memory selection and quantified irrelevant-context effects are already covered by recent work, while the proposed persistent state is only a posterior-triggered quarantine registry.
placebo-calibrated-memory-effects.finding_zh: 该方案仍然属于评估与门控流程，而不是新的学习机制。层次后验和三种重放实验臂较为具体，但把语义效应定义为“真实记忆相对无记忆的效应减去安慰剂相对无记忆的效应”，只有在安慰剂与真实记忆对所有非语义作用路径均可交换，且语义效应与非语义效应不存在交互时才具有因果有效性。令牌数、位置和任务不相交匹配无法保证这些假设；无关记忆仍可能以内容相关方式改变推理、难度、注意力或工具行为。近期工作已经覆盖基于受控干预的记忆选择和无关上下文效应量化，而该方案的持久状态仅是由后验阈值触发的隔离登记表。
placebo-calibrated-memory-effects.required_action: Replace the single irrelevant-placebo subtraction with a randomized factorial intervention that independently manipulates semantic content and surface/context properties, state the identification assumptions, and learn a transferable correction or decision model whose contribution is tested beyond the controlled audit.
placebo-calibrated-memory-effects.required_action_zh: 用随机析因干预替换单一无关安慰剂相减，使语义内容与表面或上下文属性能够被独立操纵，明确因果识别假设，并学习一个可迁移的校正或决策模型，使其贡献能够在受控审计之外接受检验。

conformal-effect-transport-gate.finding: The child is materially more precise and retains a potentially distinct selective effect-transport thesis, but its certificate is not currently valid or experimentally identifiable. Four leave-one-family-out residuals provide family-level conformal resolution no finer than 1/(4+1)=0.20; IRM, density ratios, and neighbor support do not make an unseen family exchangeable with source families; and the true effect sign on a held-out family cannot be evaluated without post-freeze target outcomes. The current method is therefore an unproved composition of conformal treatment-effect learning, cross-task conformal calibration, transfer learning, and covariate-shift risk control rather than a demonstrated new guarantee.
conformal-effect-transport-gate.finding_zh: 该子方案明显更具体，也保留了一个可能独立成立的选择性效应迁移命题，但当前证书既缺乏有效保证，也无法按所述方式完成实验识别。四个留一任务族残差在任务族层面的保形误差分辨率最多只能达到 1/(4+1)=0.20；IRM、密度比和邻域支持检查不能使未知任务族自动与源任务族可交换；而且若没有冻结后的目标任务族结果，就无法验证其真实效应符号。因此，当前方法仍是保形处理效应学习、跨任务保形校准、迁移学习和协变量偏移风险控制的未证明组合，而不是已经成立的新保证。
conformal-effect-transport-gate.required_action: Replace the current calibration and evaluation protocol with a formally stated hierarchical family-exchangeability or bounded-shift guarantee using enough calibration families, followed by post-freeze randomized target-family evaluation against the exact weighted-conformal R-learner composition.
conformal-effect-transport-gate.required_action_zh: 用具有足够校准任务族的分层任务族可交换性或有界分布偏移保证，替换当前校准与评测协议，并在全部冻结后通过随机化目标任务族实验，与完全对应的加权保形 R-learner 组合进行比较。

conformal-effect-transport-gate.strongest_baseline: A cross-fitted R-learner using the identical representation and support gate, calibrated with weighted conformal risk control and meta-conformal task calibration.
conformal-effect-transport-gate.decisive_pilot: Pre-register alpha and the family-level exchangeability or shift assumptions, calibrate on enough source families, freeze every learned component, and evaluate hidden randomized effects on a new family and second model while matching source replays, model calls, admission coverage, and training budget.
conformal-effect-transport-gate.stop_rule: Stop if empirical sign error exceeds the promised finite-sample bound in any pre-specified held-out family or model, or if coverage-adjusted risk does not improve over the composed baseline at at least 40% admission coverage.

verified-risk-predicate-grammar.finding: This is directly covered as a recombination of existing rule-learning and agent-guardrail mechanisms. AutoSpec already evolves safety rules from labeled traces through counterexample-guided inductive logic programming and candidate verification; AgentSpec supplies an executable safety DSL; and ShieldAgent constructs verifiable action-rule circuits and uses executable formal verification. MDL compression, a specificity lattice, and abstention modify this established pipeline but do not define a new learning mechanism. The proposed ground truth is also circular if the same transition verifier supplies induction labels, candidate acceptance, and final evaluation.
verified-risk-predicate-grammar.finding_zh: 该方案属于现有规则学习与智能体护栏机制的直接重组。AutoSpec 已经利用带标签轨迹、反例引导的归纳逻辑编程和候选验证持续演化安全规则；AgentSpec 提供可执行安全 DSL；ShieldAgent 则构造可验证的动作规则电路并执行形式化验证。加入 MDL 压缩、特异性格结构和弃判机制，只是在修改已有流水线，并未形成新的学习机制。如果同一个状态转移验证器同时提供归纳标签、候选规则接纳依据和最终评测标签，其所谓独立真值还会形成循环监督。
verified-risk-predicate-grammar.required_action: Replace the learned object or supervision loop with a mechanism that cannot be reduced to verified rule induction, and evaluate it using a separate transition oracle that is never used for candidate generation or acceptance.
verified-risk-predicate-grammar.required_action_zh: 必须更换学习对象或监督闭环，使其不能被归约为可验证规则归纳，并使用从未参与候选生成或接纳的独立状态转移预言机完成评测。

verified-risk-predicate-grammar.strongest_baseline: AutoSpec instantiated on the identical DSL, traces, annotations, and transition verifier, with AgentSpec or ShieldAgent enforcement and an uncompressed verified-trace-store ablation.
verified-risk-predicate-grammar.decisive_pilot: Induce rules on transition system A and freeze them for system B; under identical verifier calls, memory size, candidate budget, and inference tokens, compare the MDL grammar with AutoSpec and ShieldAgent-style rule circuits using unsafe states and outcomes enumerated by a separate transition oracle.
verified-risk-predicate-grammar.stop_rule: Stop if the grammar does not improve both violation recall and false-positive rate over AutoSpec at matched abstention and grammar size, or if any gain disappears when evaluation is switched to the external oracle.

paired-regret-update-policy.finding: The complete-outcome data assumption is materially different from ordinary offline control, but the proposed learner is not a new mechanism. When every Y_a is observed for the same state, r(a,b)=Y_b-Y_a is an algebraically redundant reparameterization of multi-output outcome regression. Enforcing antisymmetry and cycle consistency collapses the pairwise model back to scalar utilities, while omitting those constraints permits cyclic and incoherent decisions. Regret-focused losses, counterfactual pairwise comparisons, pessimistic bounds, and support-aware policy selection are already established. Moreover, forcing a fixed future candidate sequence across continue, commit, rollback, and stop may produce invalid counterfactual labels when those actions change subsequent candidates.
paired-regret-update-policy.finding_zh: 完整动作结果这一数据假设确实不同于普通离线控制，但所提出的学习器并不是新机制。当同一状态下每个动作的 Y_a 都已观测时，r(a,b)=Y_b−Y_a 只是多输出结果回归的代数冗余重参数化。若强制反对称性和环一致性，成对模型会退化回标量效用模型；若不强制，则可能产生循环且不一致的决策。面向遗憾的损失、反事实成对比较、悲观界和支持感知的策略选择均已有直接先例。此外，当继续、提交、回滚和停止会改变后续候选时，强行固定未来候选序列可能产生无效的反事实标签。
paired-regret-update-policy.required_action: Replace complete-outcome pairwise regression with a genuinely non-equivalent partial-feedback or structurally constrained regret estimator, and establish its advantage over a capacity-matched scalar full-information policy learner.
paired-regret-update-policy.required_action_zh: 必须用真正无法等价归约的部分反馈估计器或结构化遗憾估计器替换完整结果的成对回归，并证明其相对于容量匹配的标量全信息策略学习器具有独立优势。

paired-regret-update-policy.strongest_baseline: A capacity-matched multi-output utility regressor or direct cost-sensitive policy classifier trained on the same complete four-action outcomes, with identical bootstrap or conformal lower bounds and the same support gate.
